home.subject: night 10: Added buzzer awareness: press player strikes at the opponent goal (kick_toward attack_goal_xy) when time_remaining_s <= 3.0 and within 2.5 m of the ball, instead of dribbling. Rationale: the buzzer cuts all robot power but the ball keeps moving under physics, so a ball already struck goal-ward cannot be blocked after the horn. Verified obs key against RFL_RULES.md and skill shape against reference
